Memory guide

Understanding PC memory

Choose the right RAM for your platform.

On this pageCapacityDDR generationSpeed and latencyNext step

Capacity

Working memory available to the system, measured in GB. Add the capacity of all installed modules.

DDR generation

DDR3, DDR4, and DDR5 require compatible hardware. Desktop DIMMs and laptop SODIMMs also differ.

Speed and latency

Transfer rate describes data movement. CAS latency is measured in clock cycles; consider both rather than treating either as a score.
